description: Metadata for confirmed public Holistic AI research and publication pages on www.holisticai.com. Each row was stored only after one bounded GET returned that page's HTML and robots.txt allowed the path. A Cloudflare challenge, a captcha, a product console, a login page, and an off-host redirect are not stored. Entries keep a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights label. Page bodies are not stored. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, and CC BY-NC-ND keep their own tokens. A missing publication date stays unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. This catalog is not a belief collector and runner_wired is false.
